enchantments.tooltip: +6 Enhancement Bonus: +6 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.

Greater Disruption: On Hit: 4 to 24 Bane damage to Undead.On Vorpal Hit: If an undead struck by this weapon has fewer than 2000 Hit Points, it is instantly slain. If the undead has above 2000 Hit Points, it takes 200 damage.

Greater Disruption Guard: This Item stores a holy and righteous power deep within. When the wearer of this item is successfully attacked in melee by undead, this power occasionally comes to the surface, annihilating enemy undead.
Heal +17: Passive: +17 Competence bonus to the Heal skill.
Repair +17: Passive: +17 Competence bonus to the Repair skill.
